name: milestone-list
title: Milestone List
description: The ordered milestones of a piece of work: state diamond, name, weight chip when not 1, tasks done, a warning and the date; editors reorder by drag, long-press and keyboard, toggle done, open a row menu and add.

meta.whenToUse: The big steps of an initiative or project, in order, with their dates and progress.
meta.whenNotToUse: A checklist of tasks (TaskList), a plain reorderable settings list (SortableList), or a timeline of dated work (Timeline).
